---
title: "Scripts and batches"
---

## The script template

A script is a Python file in `scripts/` with:

- a header docstring (Name, Description, Author, Version, Inputs);
- `PARAMS`: a list of `Param` (they drive the form, the help and the AI tool);
- `run(signals, **params) -> Result`: computation only, no display, no file output;
- optionally `plot(result, fig)`;
- a `__main__` block so that the script also runs on its own.

`/edit_script rms_band` creates `scripts/rms_band.py` from the template (a working example
that computes an RMS in a band) and opens it in your editor (`[console] editor`, `$EDITOR`,
`nano` or `vi`). When you close the editor, the syntax is checked and you can edit again.

## Running scripts

```text
ots> /scripts                         # list with descriptions
ots> /run_script rms_band S1 fmax=20  # result displayed and stored like any analysis
```

```python
run_script("rms_band", "S1", fmax=20)
```

Standalone, on files:

```bash
python scripts/rms_band.py --files "data/*.mseed" --param fmax=20 --out results.csv
onthesignal run scripts/rms_band.py --files data/a.mseed --unit V --sensitivity 2.384e-6
```

## Batches

`/batch` runs an analysis or a script on every channel of every file and writes one row per
file and channel (units in the CSV header); a failing file is recorded in an `error` column and
does not stop the batch:

```text
ots> /batch noise "data/*.mseed" fmax=50 remove_mains=true out=noise.csv
ots> /batch rms_band data/a.mseed data/b.mseed unit=V sensitivity=2.384e-6 out=rms.json
```

```python
rows = batch("noise", ["data/*.mseed"], out="noise.csv", fmax=50)
```

In the web interface, *New batch…* in the *Scripts* view opens a form and follows the batch
in a tab, file by file ([Web interface](web.qmd#reports-scripts-and-batches)).

AI-generated scripts (`/ai_script`) follow the same template and start with a
"Generated by AI — review before use" line.
